[A10] Found by the compliance-matrix audit of `docs/00_MILAN_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW.md` at main 6a878f6 (owner request, 2026-09-18). The matrix Cov column grades the ORIGINAL architecture document; this ticket records what the tree carries today. Baseline at that head: `./scripts/run_suites.sh` exit 0 (30 of 30 suites, 14790 checks), `./scripts/lint_hdl.sh` exit 0.

## REQ-SRP-001 (Milan Table 4.3, shall) - audit verdict PARTIAL

MRP timers: joinTime 200 ms (180-240), LeaveTime 5000 ms (4500-7500), leavealltimer 10-15 s, periodictimer 1000 ms (900-1500).

- In `hdl/` today: hdl/srp/KL_srp_top.sv:72-77 (JOIN_MS_P=200, PERIODIC_MS_P=1000, LEAVE_MS_P=5000), :945 (draw_kind_o = 3 -> 10000..15000 ms), :1046-1049 (LeaveAll deadline = now + draw), :1063-1068 and :1080-1091 (join/periodic re-arm at now + constant); hdl/common/KL_pp_prng.sv:156 (kind 3 base 10000 limit 5000); LeaveTime arm at hdl/srp/KL_srp_talker_fsm.sv:666 and KL_srp_listener_fsm.sv:659 (now + LEAVE_MS_P). The top instantiates KL_srp_top with the defaults (protocol_processor_top.sv:2111-2123).
- In `tb/` today: LeaveTime 5000 graded exactly: tb/srp_stream_fsms/sim_main.cpp:123,546,689 (ARM deadline == NOW + 5000 on both registrars) and end to end tb/srp_top/sim_main.cpp:764-770 (F2: no unregister at the frame, unregistered after 5400 ms). leavealltimer range graded at the generator: tb/prng/sim_main.cpp:70-72,260-276,317 (kind 3 bounds 10000..15000, endpoints reached); integration only upper-bounded: tb/srp_top/sim_main.cpp:717-721 (F1: LeaveAll PDU within 16 s). joinTime and periodictimer: no check. The only join-related bounds are liveness timeouts (srp_top :508 'first MSRP frame within 1 s', wait_frame 800 ms at :555-567; pp_top :7840 1.2 s); sync() at srp_top :429-437 uses the 200 ms / 1000 ms phase for alignment without asserting it.
- Missing: (1) joinTime: no test measures the spacing of consecutive join-paced MRPDUs or pins JOIN_MS_P; JOIN_MS_P=400 would pass every suite. (2) periodictimer: no test observes the 1000 ms periodic! re-join period at KL_srp_top (the FSM suites drive periodic_tick_i by hand). (3) leavealltimer: integration has no lower bound (no check that a LeaveAll never fires before 10 s, nor that successive own LeaveAlls are 10-15 s apart), so draw_kind_o wired to another kind is not directly graded. Related but distinct: issue #29 (a received LeaveAll does not restart the local leavealltimer).
- Searched with: JOIN_MS|PERIODIC_MS|LEAVE_MS; T-MRP|T_MRP; joinTime|periodictimer|leavealltimer; 200|1000|5000|10000|15000|4500|7500|180|240|900|1500 in tb/srp_*; now_ms|stamp|cadence in tb/srp_top and tb/pp_top; CAD_JOIN|CAD_PERIODIC|CAD_LA (confidence: high)

## Acceptance

1. tb/srp_top timestamps every captured MRPDU with now_ms_o; with one applicant in a member state the spacing of consecutive join-paced PDUs is asserted inside 180..240 ms
2. The periodic! re-join (JoinMt/JoinIn of a quiet declared attribute) is asserted to recur every 900..1500 ms
3. First own MSRP and MVRP LeaveAll not before 10 s after arming and consecutive own LeaveAlls 10..15 s apart (no peer LeaveAll injected in that window, see #29)
4. Mutations JOIN_MS_P=400, PERIODIC_MS_P=3000 and draw_kind_o=3'd0 each turn the suite red and are recorded in tb/srp_top/README.md

Matrix finding link: GAP-04.

Executor and reviewers: assigned when the lane opens.
